about: Blind same-judge scope-miss judgings on the DeepSWE scope set (bench/deepswe-scope-set.txt). Each pack put one run of each arm per task side by side under random labels (key.json maps label -> run folder); two judges (X, Y) each judged every task, half 1 = first 7 tasks, half 2 = last 7. A verdict is 1 for a scope miss, 0 for none. Record: docs/records/baseline-deepswe.md.

arms.jev2-run: check step + Jev with the reason stated, round 1
arms.accept-run: check step + second look + acceptance rule, round 1
arms.accept-run2: check step + second look + acceptance rule, round 2

multi4a.extra: over-*.json: count of changes beyond the request, any kind

multi3a2.extra: un-*.json: count of changes beyond the request with no good reason

focus5.about: Per-place questions on the three tasks that used Jev; X.json and Y.json give covered/missed/not_needed per place and label.
